label: NASA navigation
description: Orion's trajectory from NASA's navigation team, via JPL Horizons. The reference every model is scored against.

label: Earth only
description: Earth as a point mass and nothing else. Blind to the Moon, so it cannot fly a lunar flyby.

label: Earth + bulge
description: Adds Earth's equatorial bulge (J2). It matters near Earth and hardly at all out by the Moon.

label: Earth + Moon
description: Adds the Moon's gravity, with the Moon where JPL's ephemeris puts it. The first tier that can fly the flyby.

label: Earth + Moon + Sun
description: Adds the Sun's pull, which differs slightly between Earth and Orion. The engine's best model here.

label: No corrections
description: The best model again, but flown without NASA's four course-correction burns. How far off Orion would have been if nobody had corrected its course.
